title: 第5章 一阶食铁者第6章 像肢解数学题一样肢解
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
早上吃饭，只有冯睦和母亲王秀丽两个人。
他这个时候才知道，原来昨晚上巡捕房接了大案子，冯钜彻夜未归，冯雨槐则是因为根骨优异，已于昨日荣升为住校生了。
住校，可是优等生才能享有的特权，意味着被学校重点关注，可以24小时使用武道教室，并在放学后的夜晚，被老师继续上…课。
不涉黄，都别想歪了。
王秀丽是个作息规律的人，昨晚早早就睡下了，根本不晓得儿子回来的究竟有多晚。
“你妹妹根骨好，以后能出息，也会帮到你的。”
看着自家木讷，沉默扒拉饭的儿子，王秀丽小声的安慰了一句。
冯睦吞掉最后一口饭，唔了一声，提起书包准备出门。
王秀丽将一条中和剂递过去，有点愧疚道：“记得吃掉，还有，莫要怨你爸偏心，他也是为了这个家。”
中和剂，看起来像辣条，实则口感如同塑胶，是用来抑制或祛除体内的核辐射因子的，普通人一个月需要吃一根，预防畸变。
“嗯，我知道，我就是有点舍不得，想在学校再赖几天，没想着再参加高考，反正我也考不过，下周我就办理退学手续，以后找个班上，贴补家用。”
这绝对是冯睦穿越三年来，跟家人说的最长的一句话。
他倒不算撒谎，因为学校里真的有他暂时割舍不掉的牵挂。
王秀丽讪讪一笑，愧疚的给儿子一些零花钱。
冯睦没拒绝，塞进口袋里，出门而去。
出了小区，轻车熟路的来到五金店，二话不说称量一斤铁珠子，也不装书包，就塞在裤子口袋里。
没事儿就偷偷往嘴里塞两颗，吃糖豆子似的，也不嚼就生吞入肚。
骑到学校的时候，口袋已经空了一半。
“肚子有点胀痛，吃不下了，是因为吃早饭的缘故吗，怎么感觉就撑着了？”
冯睦皱眉揉了揉肚子，眼前突兀弹出一个对话框。

[食铁者：一阶]
[可食用铁类：1]
[可汲取金属特性：1]
[当前检测食用铁类——普通生铁，食用度0.5%。]
[已汲取特性：？？]
……
冯睦愣了一下。
“食铁就变强，所以，食用度指食铁变强的进度，直接数据化，倒是很直观清晰，也符合游戏特性。”
“不光能变强，还能汲取金属特性，感觉有点牛逼。”
“有一阶，就说明还有二阶，或者三阶四阶？”
冯睦心头顿时火烫，唯一的疑惑就是他不记得，游戏里的技能词条还能提升等阶啊。
毕竟，游戏主打势力经营养成，角色战斗和技能系统相对拉胯也情有可原。
[提示：本游戏已加载入现实，为了更好的适应新版本，游戏已做打了全方位的升级补丁，请玩家自行摸索，勿要大惊小怪。]
冯睦懂了。
怎么说呢？
都银色稀有度了，还能继续升阶，这个技能补丁多少带点卷逼成分了，不过，我稀饭。
“[食铁者]可以继续升阶，那其他两个金色技能呢？”
冯睦觉得应该是不能的，毕竟已经金色，到顶了，再升就超模了，但也不好说，还需找机会验证一下。
脑子里做着各种计较，回过神来的时候，冯睦已经站在教室门口了。
空了13的教室，里面的同学齐刷刷的看过来，似乎没人料到，冯睦今天还会来上课。

“昨天留在教室的那些人不都退学了吗？”
“对啊，他怎么又来了？”
“他不会打算参加高考吧？”
content_en:
At dinner in the morning, there were only Feng Mu and his mother Wang Xiuli.
Only then did he find out that Feng Ju had stayed away from the police station last night to take on a big case, and Feng Yuhuai had been promoted to a dormitory student yesterday because of his excellent character.
Living on campus is a privilege that only top students can enjoy. It means that they are paid special attention to by the school, can use the martial arts classroom 24 hours a day, and can continue to have classes with teachers at night after school.
If it’s not pornographic, don’t even think about it.
Wang Xiuli is a person with a regular schedule. She went to bed early last night and had no idea how late her son came back.
"Your sister has good bones and will be able to help you if she succeeds in the future."
Looking at her son who was dull and silent, Wang Xiuli comforted her in a low voice.
Feng Mu swallowed the last mouthful of rice, sighed, picked up his schoolbag and prepared to go out.
Wang Xiuli handed over a neutralizer and said a little guiltily: "Remember to eat it. Also, don't blame your father for being partial. He is doing it for this family too."
Neutralizer, which looks like spicy strips but actually tastes like plastic, is used to inhibit or eliminate nuclear radiation factors in the body. Ordinary people need to eat one stick a month to prevent distortion.
"Well, I know. I'm just a little reluctant. I want to stay in school for a few more days. I don't want to take the college entrance examination again. I can't pass it anyway. I will go through the withdrawal procedures next week and find a class to supplement my family income."
This is definitely the longest sentence Feng Mu has said to his family in the three years since he traveled through time.
He wasn't lying, because there was really a concern in school that he couldn't let go of for the time being.
Wang Xiuli smiled and gave her son some pocket money guiltily.
Feng Mu did not refuse, stuffed it into his pocket, and went out.
After leaving the community, I went to the hardware store with ease. Without saying anything, I weighed a pound of iron beads and put them in my schoolbag. I just stuffed them into my pants pocket.
When nothing happens, he secretly stuffs two pellets into his mouth, as if eating jelly beans, and swallows them raw without chewing them.
When I rode to school, my pockets were already half empty.
"My stomach is a little bloated and I can't eat anymore. Is it because of breakfast? Why do I feel so full?"
Feng Mu frowned and rubbed his stomach, and a dialog box suddenly popped up in front of his eyes.
[Iron Eater: Level 1]
[Edible iron: 1]
[Extractable metal properties: 1]
[Currently tested edible iron - ordinary pig iron, edible content 0.5%. ]
[Characteristics learned:? ? ]
…
Feng Mu was stunned for a moment.
"Eating iron will make you stronger. Therefore, the consumption degree refers to the progress of iron becoming stronger. It is directly digitized, which is very intuitive and clear, and is in line with the characteristics of the game."
"Not only can it become stronger, but it can also absorb the properties of metal. It feels a bit awesome."
"If there is one level, does that mean there is a second level, or a third level or a fourth level?"
Feng Mu's heart suddenly became hot. His only doubt was that he didn't remember that the skill entries in the game could also be upgraded.
After all, the main focus of the game is on power management and development, so it is understandable that the character combat and skill systems are relatively stretched.
[Tip: This game has been loaded into reality. In order to better adapt to the new version, the game has been fully upgraded and patched. Players are asked to explore on their own without making a fuss. ]
Feng Mu understood.
How to say it?
It's already silver rarity, and it can continue to be upgraded. This skill patch has a bit of a twist, but I don't like it.
"[Iron Eater] can continue to level up, but what about the other two golden skills?"
Feng Mu felt that it shouldn't be possible. After all, he was already golden. If he reached the top, he would be a supermodel. But it was hard to say. He still needed to find a chance to verify it.
He was making various calculations in his mind. When he came to his senses, Feng Mu was already standing at the door of the classroom.
In the empty classroom of 13, all the students inside looked over. It seemed that no one expected that Feng Mu would come to class today.
"Didn't those who stayed in the classroom yesterday drop out?"
"Yes, why is he here again?"
"HeDon't you plan to take the college entrance examination? "
